nodes.label: Step 4 "Notify Compliance": review "Will notify on create"

nodes.label: Show DealRail: "Full Array" and "Focus" tabs

"Assigned to {X}"; "Save progress" and "Mark step complete" disabled (API: 403 "Not permitted to edit step work")

nodes.label: Lock actions: "Ahead of the cursor. Advance the rail to act on this step."

nodes.label: Add the result to "Run history": "Version 1 of 1"; "Mark complete" stays a human action

nodes.label: Click "Review output": edit a passage or "Add comment", then "Apply N edit(s)"

nodes.label: Required fields filled?

nodes.label: Click "Remove", then "Remove step" (to "Removed steps", with "Restore")
